flow_name.description: Name of the security-sensitive flow being verified (e.g. oauth_authorization_code_flow, payment_transfer_flow). Used to scope the invariant check.

invariants.description: List of invariants to verify. Each invariant is a testable claim about the flow. The invariant-checker does NOT generate invariants (per D16) — the caller supplies them.

id.description: Stable identifier for this invariant (e.g. INV-01, SCOPE-BIND-01). Used in the verdict to correlate results.

statement.description: Natural-language statement of the invariant (e.g. 'granted scope must equal the scope from the authorization request, not the consent form submission').

anchor_symbols.description: Optional list of fully-qualified Go symbols that anchor this invariant check (helps the agent locate the relevant code).

review_session_id.description: UUID identifying the current security review session.

code_ref.description: Git reference of the code being reviewed.

code_ref_dirty.description: True if the working tree has uncommitted changes at review time.
